title: fix(ui): record delete says it cannot be undone and the toast names the record
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删除单条记录时，确认框现在写明「此操作无法撤销」；删除成功的提示写出记录名，例如 `Task "Website Relaunch" deleted`，批量删除仍报条数。十个语言包都有。
- 为什么改：平台没有回收站，删除不可恢复，但原确认框只问「确定要删除吗」，提示只说「Record deleted」，删错了事前没有警告、事后也看不出删了哪条。
- 风险与回滚：只改文案和 toast 取名，不改删除行为；新增一个语言键 `objectActions.deletedNamed`。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/core/src/actions/recordDelete.ts`（`successText` 与 `run` 的单条分支）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`（记录页删除段）、`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/recordDelete.test.ts packages/i18n/src/__tests__/record-delete-permanent-27823.test.ts`，预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27823

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Measured on `origin/main` at `359e935d` before the edit. Every one-record delete entry point asks through the shared `recordDelete.confirmCopy` in `@object-ui/core`, and the copy question is `objectActions.deleteConfirm`:

| Entry point | Confirm body (before) | Success toast (before) |
|---|---|---|
| Record page header Delete (`RecordDetailView`) | `objectActions.deleteConfirm` | `detail.deleted` "Record deleted" |
| Console list row Delete (`useObjectActions.deleteRecord`) | `objectActions.deleteConfirm` | `objectActions.deleteSuccess` "{{label}} deleted successfully" |
| Console bulk Delete (`useObjectActions.deleteRecords`) | `console.objectView.bulkDeleteConfirm` (already "This cannot be undone.") | `objectActions.bulkDeleteSuccess` (count) |
| Object-view grid row / bulk Delete (`plugin-view` `ObjectView`) | same keys as the console list | same keys as the console list |
| plugin-detail `DetailView` `handleDelete` | `detail.deleteConfirmation` (native confirm) | none (host's `onDelete`) |

After:

- **Permanence.** `objectActions.deleteConfirm` and `detail.deleteConfirmation` end with the pack's own permanence sentence, the exact sentence `console.objectView.bulkDeleteConfirm` already ends with, in all ten packs (en "This cannot be undone.", zh "此操作无法撤销。"). The inline fallback maps in `plugin-view` and `plugin-detail` match `en`.
- **Named toast.** New `recordDelete.successText(deps, record)`: the object label plus the record's display name from `getRecordDisplayName` (the resolver the confirm title already uses). The resolver's `Record #id` floor is not a name, so a nameless record keeps `objectActions.deleteSuccess`, the same rule the record-save toasts (`form.createdNamed`) follow. `recordDelete.run` uses it for one record (the row from `params.record`, or the single `params.records` entry) and takes an optional `objectDef` so the name follows the declared `nameField`; the console list and the object-view grid now pass it. The record page uses the same helper over the same readable row its confirm title reads.
- **Batch unchanged.** A bulk delete keeps its count toast.
- **No Undo**, per the ruling: there is nothing to restore from.
- `@object-ui/i18n` gains `objectActions.deletedNamed` (`{{label}} "{{name}}" deleted`, each pack in its `form.createdNamed` style, so `de` uses „…“).

Overlap: none. Seat 4's PR #27793 edits `RecordDetailView.tsx` `apiHandler` only; this PR edits only the header Delete `onClick` there. `origin/main` was merged before the PR (14 commits, no file in common).

## Tests

- `core/src/actions/__tests__/recordDelete.test.ts`: `successText` names the record by its declared name field; a nameless record (`Record #id` floor) and a missing row keep the object-label toast; `run` names the `params.record` row; control: the batch toast keeps its count.
- `i18n/src/__tests__/record-delete-permanent-27823.test.ts`: in each of the ten packs both one-record questions end with that pack's batch permanence sentence (read from the pack, not written out), and `deletedNamed` interpolates exactly `{{label}}` and `{{name}}`.
- `RecordDetailView.deleteConfirmDialog-11001.test.tsx`: the record page's dialog body carries the permanence sentence and the success toast is the named one.
- `ObjectView.gridDelete-10383.test.tsx`: the grid row Delete's question and named toast.
- Updated pins: `residue-namespaces-3546` (`detail.deleted` left the inline-default table because its call site is gone, accounted for like `kanban.columns`), `de-quote-pairing-3876` (one more „…“ pair: 100 → 101).

<details><summary>Ablations (two legs, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to HEAD blob)</summary>

1. `recordDelete.successText` returns `objectActions.deleteSuccess` unconditionally (anchor 1 → 0, blob `5dc54382` → `c23705e9`): 4 failed / 23 passed across `recordDelete.test.ts`, `ObjectView.gridDelete-10383`, `RecordDetailView.deleteConfirmDialog-11001`. The nameless-record case and the batch control stayed green, as they should. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. `en` `objectActions.deleteConfirm` without the sentence (blob `bec64d03` → `ffdb6618`): 2 failed / 23 passed (`record-delete-permanent-27823` en case, `RecordDetailView.deleteConfirmDialog-11001` dialog case). Restored: blob == HEAD.

</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

Final head `6ff4636e` (branch tip `c92450e9` + a merge of `origin/main`, 14 commits, no file in common).

- Targeted, pre-merge: 97 files, 1448 passed / 13 skipped (core recordDelete, all of `i18n/src/__tests__/`, the object-view grid delete, the record page delete dialog and confirm parity, both `useObjectActions` suites).
- Neighbours, pre-merge: `core/src/actions/`, `plugin-view/`, `plugin-detail/` and the other files that pin these keys: 468 files, 4579 passed / 18 skipped.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`): 33 of 34 run, every one exit 0; the 34th, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, ran alone after the merge (below).

- After the merge, on `6ff4636e`: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, rebuilt the `@object-ui/app-shell` closure (lock VERDICT exit 0), then `type-check` exit 0 for `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-view`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell`; `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` 171 files, 4902 passed / 2 skipped; the targeted set again 97 files, 1448 passed / 13 skipped.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 34 derived families accounted for, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The 33 `check:*` / node gates ran on `c92450e9` (pre-merge; the merge touched none of this diff's files).
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `detail.deleted` ("Record deleted") has no call site after this PR. The key is left in the packs: retiring it is the dead-key sweep's call (`check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs`, report-only), the same disposition `kanban.columns` got.
- Out of scope, not changed: an author-declared bulk action with `operation: 'delete'` in `ObjectGrid`'s `BulkActionDialog` shows its own declared copy; the built-in Delete paths above are the ones the card names.
- plugin-detail's `DetailView` delete still asks through `window.confirm`; only its copy changed here.

## Verification

CI runs the full ui battery (Type Check UI, Test UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI).
